hunks.baseline: Silence hung over the fast ship as it cut rapidly through the current.
hunks.sol: Silence hung over the swift ships as they sliced through the current.

hunks.baseline: The river bandits of Water Dragon Stronghold rowed like machines with their mouths pressed tightly shut, while Mu Song did nothing but stare ahead with a stiff, frozen expression.
hunks.sol: The river pirates of Water Dragon Stronghold rowed like machines, their mouths clamped shut, while Mu Song stared straight ahead with a rigid expression.

hunks.baseline: *What a wonderful atmosphere.*
hunks.sol: *What a fantastic atmosphere.*

hunks.baseline: There were four fast ships heading toward Donghu Stronghold.
hunks.sol: Four swift ships were currently bound for Donghu Stronghold.

hunks.baseline: But the atmosphere aboard them was worlds apart from when we had been heading toward Hubei.
hunks.sol: But the mood aboard them was worlds apart from when we had been sailing toward Hubei.

hunks.baseline: The reason was the unfamiliar faces that had not been there before.
hunks.sol: The unfamiliar faces now filling the ships were the reason.

hunks.baseline: Disciples from the two prestigious great factions that divided Hubei Province filled the four fast ships.
hunks.sol: Disciples of the two prestigious factions that divided Hubei Province between them filled all four vessels.

hunks.baseline: It was obvious at a glance that they were elites carefully selected in preparation for any unforeseen bloodshed. Every one of them was an outstanding martial artist.
hunks.sol: One glance was enough to tell that they were elites, handpicked in preparation for possible bloodshed. Every last one of them was an exceptional martial artist.

hunks.baseline: And at the center of them stood two people.
hunks.sol: And at their center stood two men.

hunks.baseline: At the old Daoist’s words, Zhuge Feng answered in an untroubled voice.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Feng answered the old Daoist in an untroubled voice.

hunks.baseline: “You need not worry. If the wind is blowing like this, things will actually be easier for us.”
hunks.sol: “There is no need to worry. With a wind like this, things may actually be easier for us.”

hunks.baseline: “Why is that? I understand that dozens of ships have already sunk in winds weaker than this.”
hunks.sol: “Why is that? I understand dozens of ships have already sunk in winds weaker than this.”

hunks.baseline: “The boatmen’s skill is one thing, but the fast ships that serve as the symbol of the Yangtze River Channel League are qualitatively different from ordinary vessels. Rather than being swept away by strong winds, they can catch the force and move forward with even greater vigor.”
hunks.sol: “The boatmen’s skill is one factor, but the swift ships that symbolize the Yangtze River Channel League are in a class of their own. Rather than being swept away by strong winds, they can catch the wind and surge forward with even greater force.”

hunks.baseline: “I have heard some talk about fast ships as well… but I do not know the details, as my experience is limited. I have spent my entire life in Murim, yet it feels as though I have wasted it.”
hunks.sol: “I have heard a little about swift ships myself… but my experience is limited, so I know none of the details. I have spent my entire life in Murim, yet moments like this make me feel as though I have wasted it.”

hunks.baseline: “Since you have remained at Wudang’s headquarters all this time, it is understandable that you would not know. But… may I ask what became of the matter you mentioned last time?”
hunks.sol: “You have spent all that time at Wudang’s headquarters, so it is only natural that you would not know. But… may I ask what became of the matter you mentioned last time?”

hunks.baseline: “Our Sect Leader is personally working on it together with the disciples of our main sect. As for me, I was sent here instead, since all I was doing was sitting around and consuming the sect’s grain.”
hunks.sol: “Our Sect Leader is personally working on it with the disciples of the main sect. In exchange, he sent this old Daoist here, since I was doing nothing but sitting around and consuming grain.”

hunks.baseline: “Consuming grain? With Perfected Being Hyeongong joining us, this junior feels as though he has gained a thousand troops and ten thousand horses.”
hunks.sol: “Doing nothing but consuming grain? With Perfected Being Hyeongong joining us, this junior feels as though he has gained an army of thousands.”

hunks.baseline: Zhuge Feng’s words were not mere courtesy. They were true.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Feng was not merely being polite. He meant every word.

hunks.baseline: That was the Daoist title of the old man wearing a patched Daoist robe and carrying a single Pine-Pattern Ancient Sword at his waist.
hunks.sol: That was the Daoist name of the old man in the heavily patched robe, with a single worn Pine-Pattern Ancient Sword hanging at his waist.

hunks.baseline: His position within Wudang and his generational seniority in Murim were in no way inferior to Zhuge Feng’s.
hunks.sol: Neither his position within Wudang nor his generational seniority in Murim was inferior to Zhuge Feng’s.

hunks.baseline: No, one could even say that he stood shoulder to shoulder with Zhuge Feng—or above him.
hunks.sol: If anything, he stood equal to Zhuge Feng—or even above him.

hunks.baseline: Unlike Zhuge Feng, who had not yet reached sixty, Perfected Being Hyeongong was a master of the previous generation who had distinguished himself during the Great Faction War. He was also the current Wudang Sect Leader’s Junior Brother.
hunks.sol: Unlike Zhuge Feng, who had yet to turn sixty, Perfected Being Hyeongong was a master of the previous generation who had distinguished himself during the Great Faction War. He was also the current Wudang Sect Leader’s Junior Brother.

hunks.baseline: *On top of that, he’s one of Wudang’s famed Supreme Peak masters.*
hunks.sol: *And one of the Supreme Peak masters Wudang is so proud of.*

hunks.baseline: Perfected Being Hyeongong was the swordsman said to have reached the ultimate stage of Wudang’s greatest technique, the Taiji Wisdom Sword.
hunks.sol: Perfected Being Hyeongong was the swordsman said to have reached the ultimate depths of Wudang’s supreme technique, the Taiji Wisdom Sword.

hunks.baseline: The fact that Zhuge Feng, Family Head of the Zhuge Clan, spoke so respectfully even in front of others was itself a sign of his respect for Hyeongong.
hunks.sol: Even as Family Head of the Zhuge Clan, Zhuge Feng spoke to him with marked respect in front of everyone. That alone showed the regard he had for Hyeongong.

hunks.baseline: Ah, of course, there was one exception to all of this.
hunks.sol: Of course, there was one exception to all this.

hunks.baseline: “That guy’s grown a lot.”
hunks.sol: “That little punk has grown.”

hunks.baseline: At the words of Jeok Cheongang—Murim’s own Bodhidharma and the ultimate old-timer—I muttered in disbelief.
hunks.sol: At the words of Jeok Cheongang—Murim’s own Bodhidharma-tier old-timer—I muttered in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: “Sure has. He’s grown so much that his beard has turned white.”
hunks.sol: “He sure has. He’s grown so much his beard turned white.”

hunks.baseline: “How old was that fellow the last time I saw him? Thirty?”
“Ha. Time really flies. Those young pups with soft fuzz on their faces are all Sect Leaders and Elders now.”
hunks.sol: “How old was he the last time I saw him? Thirty? Hah. Time certainly flies. Those soft-fuzzed little brats have all become Sect Leaders and Elders.”

hunks.baseline: “Soft fuzz? If he was thirty, wouldn’t he have had a full bush down there?”
hunks.sol: “Soft fuzz? At thirty, wouldn’t he have had a full bush down there?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang glared at me with blazing eyes.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang glared at me with fire in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: “Judging by the way you keep nitpicking my words, it seems you want every hair below your waist plucked out.”
hunks.sol: “Judging by the way you keep nitpicking my every word, you must want every hair below your waist plucked out.”

hunks.baseline: “No, why would you say something like that?”
hunks.sol: “Why would you say something like that?”

hunks.baseline: I had not the slightest desire to undergo Fire King Zilean waxing on the deck of a fast ship.
hunks.sol: I had absolutely no desire to receive a Fire King Zilean waxing on the deck of a swift ship.

hunks.baseline: I waved my hands at lightning speed, then glanced sidelong at Jeok Cheongang.
hunks.sol: I waved my hands at the speed of light, then stole a sidelong glance at Jeok Cheongang.

hunks.baseline: “Since we’re on the subject, may I ask your venerable age?”
hunks.sol: “Since we’re on the subject, may I ask exactly how venerable your years are?”

hunks.baseline: “My venerable age?”
hunks.sol: “Venerable?”

hunks.baseline: Even under ordinary circumstances, Jeok Cheongang treated being called old as synonymous with asking him to kill you. I awkwardly tried another term.
hunks.sol: Even under normal circumstances, Jeok Cheongang treated being called old as another way of asking him to kill you. I awkwardly tried again.

hunks.baseline: “…Then, how many years have you lived, sir?”
hunks.sol: “…Then, your age?”

hunks.baseline: “How many years?”
hunks.sol: “My age?”

hunks.baseline: No, seriously. He was over a hundred years old. What more did he want from me?
hunks.sol: Seriously, what more did he want? The man was over a hundred.

hunks.baseline: I asked, thoroughly exasperated.
hunks.sol: I asked with all the exasperation I could muster.

hunks.baseline: Right. I knew this would happen.
hunks.sol: Right. I knew that would happen.

hunks.baseline: After striking the back of my head like a bolt of lightning, Jeok Cheongang answered in a bored tone.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang smacked the back of my head like a bolt of lightning, then answered in a bored voice.

hunks.baseline: “I stopped counting after I passed one hundred.”
hunks.sol: “I stopped counting after one hundred.”

hunks.baseline: “So when was the last time you counted?”
hunks.sol: “So how long ago was the last time you counted?”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung, who had been dangling from the nearby bow, opened his mouth wide.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung, who had been dangling from the nearby bow, dropped his jaw.

hunks.baseline: “Wow, five thousand years old!”
hunks.sol: “Wow! Five thousand years old!”

hunks.baseline: “…Does that fellow not know what suspicion is?”
hunks.sol: “…Does that little punk not know how to doubt anything?”

hunks.baseline: “…He’s always been like that. Anyway, you look incredibly young for your age.”
hunks.sol: “…That’s just how he is. Anyway, you look unbelievably young for your age.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang stared at me.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang stared hard at me.

hunks.baseline: “Do you want to know more?”
hunks.sol: “Would you like to know more?”

hunks.baseline: I honestly did want to know, but judging by his expression, I probably shouldn’t.
hunks.sol: Honestly, I did want to know, but judging by his expression, this was something I was better off not knowing.

hunks.baseline: He was sensitive about his age under ordinary circumstances. On top of that, the reality of riding a fast ship that was racing forward over rougher waves and stronger winds than ever before seemed to be placing an enormous amount of stress on him.
hunks.sol: He was sensitive about his age at the best of times. Worse, being aboard a swift ship racing over rougher currents and through stronger winds than ever seemed to be causing him tremendous stress.

hunks.baseline: Right then.
As if it had heard Jeok Cheongang’s complaint, the goddamned piece of wood picked up even more speed.
hunks.sol: Right then, as though it had heard his complaint, the goddamned piece of wood sped up even more.

hunks.baseline: A column of water surged high into the air, and the previously stable hull rocked from side to side.
hunks.sol: A column of water shot high into the air, and the once-steady hull began rocking from side to side.

hunks.baseline: At the sudden rough movement, Cheongpung let out a cheer like a child visiting an amusement park on Children’s Day.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung cheered at the sudden violent motion like a child visiting an amusement park on Children’s Day.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang, who still had not recovered from the aftereffects of the Yangtze taste-test incident, released ear-splitting screams. Mungyeong, who had been calmly keeping his balance by himself, tactfully grabbed the railing after noticing everyone’s eyes on him.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang, who still had not recovered from their little dip in the Yangtze, let out ear-splitting screams. Mungyeong alone remained perfectly balanced, but when he noticed everyone looking at him, he tactfully grabbed the railing.

hunks.baseline: “Uhh! Uhhhhh!”
hunks.sol: “Uhh! Uhhhhhhhh!”

hunks.baseline: He was panicking, making a noise so undignified that it rendered the title Fire King meaningless.
hunks.sol: He was panicking so badly that no one would have guessed his title was the Fire King.

hunks.baseline: Good heavens, look at those bulging eyes. He could be used in a Gangnam plastic surgeon’s subway advertisement as a successful double-eyelid surgery case.
hunks.sol: Good God, look at those bulging eyes. They could put his face across an entire subway car as a Gangnam plastic surgery clinic’s double-eyelid success story.

hunks.baseline: I dodged the water splashing into my face and shouted toward Mu Song.
hunks.sol: Dodging the water splashing into my face, I shouted at Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song cut me off with a voice as sharp as a blade.
hunks.sol: Mu Song cut me off sharply.

hunks.baseline: Like a man born and raised on the Yangtze, he stood perfectly upright as if he were on level ground. He raised one hand and pointed ahead.
hunks.sol: Like a man born and raised on the Yangtze, he stood tall as though his feet were planted on level ground. He raised one hand and pointed ahead.

hunks.baseline: I narrowed my eyes and stared in the direction of his finger.
hunks.sol: I narrowed my eyes and stared where he was pointing.

hunks.baseline: I drew up my internal energy and concentrated it in my eyes. My eyesight, enhanced by leaps and bounds, pierced through the thick fog covering the rippling river.
hunks.sol: I drew up my internal energy and focused it into my eyes. My dramatically enhanced vision pierced the dense fog blanketing the churning river.

hunks.baseline: I could see it.
hunks.sol: I saw it.

hunks.baseline: A narrow passage barely wide enough for two fast ships—the most streamlined kind of vessel—to pass through.
hunks.sol: A passage so narrow that even swift ships, among the sleekest of all vessels, could barely squeeze through two abreast.

hunks.baseline: And directly in front of it, a violent whirlpool twisting like a blade.
hunks.sol: And directly before it, a violent whirlpool twisting like a blade.

hunks.baseline: A massive log, swept in from who knew where and caught in the whirlpool, which measured more than a hundred zhang in radius, broke apart after failing to withstand the pressure of the water.
hunks.sol: A massive log that had drifted in from parts unknown was caught in the whirlpool, which stretched more than a hundred zhang in radius. Unable to withstand the crushing water pressure, it snapped apart.

hunks.baseline: Some of the splintered pieces were flung away and smashed into a huge rock standing behind the whirlpool like a gatekeeper, shattering into fragments.
hunks.sol: The splintered pieces went flying and struck a gigantic rock looming behind the whirlpool like a gatekeeper, shattering into fragments.

hunks.baseline: *A whirlpool like that in a river, not the sea?*
hunks.sol: *A whirlpool like that in a river? Not the sea, but a river?*

hunks.baseline: It was a mysterious sight, but one that sent a chill down my spine.
hunks.sol: The sight was as wondrous as it was chilling.

hunks.baseline: And every single person aboard the fast ships knew the identity of that terrifying whirlpool.
hunks.sol: And everyone aboard the swift ships knew the identity of that monstrous whirlpool.

hunks.baseline: Someone shouted the words like a scream.
hunks.sol: Someone screamed the name.

hunks.baseline: A work of nature that had transformed Donghu Stronghold of the Yangtze River Channel League into a natural fortress—and a monster that had swallowed countless lives and ships over the centuries.
hunks.sol: It was the natural barrier that had made the Yangtze River Channel League’s Donghu Stronghold an impregnable fortress—and a monster that had swallowed countless lives and ships over the long years.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang declared with a face that looked as though he might suffocate at any moment.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Turn the ship around. I would rather fight the Great Faction War one more time than cross that.”
hunks.sol: Looking as though he might suffocate at any moment, Jeok Cheongang declared, “Turn the ship around. I would rather fight the Great Faction War all over again than cross that.”

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin spoke next, their faces already looking as if they had suffocated.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin spoke next, their faces suggesting they had already suffocated.

hunks.baseline: “Senior Mu Song. Please save us. I would rather beg in a beggars’ den.”
hunks.sol: “Senior Mu Song, please save us. I would rather spend my life begging in a beggars’ den.”

hunks.baseline: “Captain. Thank you for everything. I’m quitting Murim now. I want to go home and sell silk.”
hunks.sol: “Captain, thank you for everything. I’m done with Murim. I want to go home and sell silk.”

hunks.baseline: I was afraid, too.
hunks.sol: Not that I wasn’t scared myself.

hunks.baseline: As I watched the enormous whirlpool rushing closer, I felt as though I had become an ant trapped in an antlion’s pit.
hunks.sol: Watching that enormous whirlpool rush toward us made me feel like an ant tumbling into an antlion’s pit.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck. First we’ll get smashed to bits against that rock, then we’ll be sucked in like a toilet flushing.*
hunks.sol: *Fuck. We’re going to smash against that rock and get blown to pieces, then get sucked straight down like someone flushed a toilet.*

hunks.baseline: In the face of the terror offered by Mother Nature, even the System and Supreme Peak martial arts felt utterly useless.
hunks.sol: Before the terror of nature itself, even the System and Supreme Peak martial arts seemed useless.

hunks.baseline: If someone dropped me in the middle of the Yangtze, I was confident I could somehow swim to shore. But if I were swept into a monstrous whirlpool like that…
hunks.sol: If someone dropped me into the middle of the Yangtze, I was confident I could somehow swim to shore. But if I got caught in a whirlpool like that…

hunks.baseline: That would truly be the end.
hunks.sol: Then I really was finished.

hunks.baseline: A thick hand settled on my shoulder as I took deep breaths.
hunks.sol: As I took deep breaths, a thick hand settled on my shoulder.

hunks.baseline: Even I, who was fairly tall, had to lift my head to look up at the giant. Jin Wikyung opened his mouth with a calm expression.
hunks.sol: Even as a fairly tall man myself, I had to tilt my head back to look up at the giant beside me. Jin Wikyung spoke with a calm expression.

hunks.baseline: His composure was enough to make me call him Big Brother without thinking.
hunks.sol: His composure alone made me want to call him Eldest Brother.

hunks.baseline: Putting aside Jeok Cheongang, who had a pathological hatred of water, even I had reached the Supreme Peak realm and was still feeling my blood run cold. Yet Jin Wikyung, whose martial arts were far below ours, did not waver in the slightest.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang had a pathological hatred of water, so he was one thing, but even I—a Supreme Peak master—felt my blood run cold. Yet Jin Wikyung, whose martial arts were far beneath ours, showed not the slightest trace of fear.

hunks.baseline: *So this is why he’s the eldest brother and the Lesser Family Head.*
hunks.sol: *So this is why he’s my eldest brother. Why he’s the Lesser Family Head.*

hunks.baseline: “Big Brother…”
hunks.sol: “Eldest Brother…”

hunks.baseline: “Even in death, the bond between our brothers will last forever.”
hunks.sol: “Even as ghosts, the bond between us brothers will endure forever.”

hunks.baseline: “I can see our deceased parents hovering before my eyes. It is as though they are beckoning to us from Tianling Falls.”
hunks.sol: “I can see our departed parents before my eyes. It is as though they are beckoning to us from Tianling Falls.”

hunks.baseline: “We lost contact with him again a long time ago. Let us consider him dead.”
hunks.sol: “We lost contact with him again a long time ago. Let us simply consider him dead.”

hunks.baseline: *Big brother, my ass. He’s just a big bastard.*
hunks.sol: *Eldest brother, my ass. He’s just a big bastard.*

hunks.baseline: And while he was at it, he had declared our perfectly alive father dead just because the man had dumped the family responsibilities on him and run away.
hunks.sol: Our father had dumped the entire family on him and run away, and Jin Wikyung had just declared the perfectly healthy man dead.

hunks.baseline: I looked around. Most of the people were already half out of their minds, letting their bodies move to the beat of Mother Nature.
hunks.sol: I looked around. Most of the people aboard were already half out of their minds, surrendering their bodies to the beat of Mother Nature.

hunks.baseline: I looked at Mu Song with the last of my hope.
hunks.sol: With my last shred of hope, I looked at Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: “I’m sorry, but it’s too late to stop.”
hunks.sol: “I’m sorry, but it is too late to stop.”

hunks.baseline: Mu Song nodded with a hardened expression.
hunks.sol: Mu Song nodded, his expression grim.

hunks.baseline: “Hold on tight. My men and I will do our best as well.”
hunks.sol: “Hold on tight. My men and I will do our best.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you think Tianling Falls is some common feature that can be found in every province? I have only crossed it three or four times, when I came to Hubei to see Uncle Hwang. We have no choice but to trust the League’s fast ships and the skills we have honed over the years.”
hunks.sol: “Do you think every province has its own Tianling Falls? I have only crossed it three or four times, when I came to Hubei to visit Uncle Hwang. We have no choice but to trust in the League’s swift ships and the skills we have honed over the years.”

hunks.baseline: “I do not know why Liu Bei suddenly came up, but naturally I would be unfamiliar with it. I spent all my time in Sichuan after leaving headquarters and becoming Stronghold Lord.”
hunks.sol: “I do not know why you are suddenly bringing up Liu Bei,[^1] but of course I am unfamiliar with it. Ever since leaving headquarters and becoming a Stronghold Lord, I have spent all my time in Sichuan.”

hunks.baseline: A fucking punchable one.
hunks.sol: A fucking punchable point.

hunks.baseline: Half out of my mind, I barely squeezed out my voice.
hunks.sol: Half out of my mind, I barely managed to squeeze out the words.

hunks.baseline: I turned my head at lightning speed and saw the disciples of both sects, their bodies rigid with tension, and the man standing at their center.
hunks.sol: My head snapped around at lightning speed. The disciples of both factions stood rigid with tension, and at their center was one man.

hunks.baseline: Zhuge Feng met my gaze and laughed heartily as he was pelted by the rising spray.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Feng met my gaze and laughed heartily as the rising spray pelted his face.

hunks.baseline: “A wise man leads his allies, while a strategist deceives even his allies. Since we have all climbed onto the tiger’s back, let us see this through to the bitter end!”
hunks.sol: “A wise man leads his allies, while a strategist deceives even his allies! Now that we have all climbed onto the tiger’s back, let us ride it to the bitter end!”

hunks.baseline: Was this for real?
hunks.sol: Was this really happening?

hunks.baseline: Everyone, myself included, was left speechless, while Jeok Cheongang lost his reason.
hunks.sol: Every last one of us was left speechless.

hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, meanwhile, lost his mind.

hunks.baseline: It was one of the greatest fits of rage I had ever witnessed.
hunks.sol: It was one of the most spectacular eruptions of rage I had ever witnessed.

hunks.baseline: With Mu Song’s urgent shout, the whirlpool of Tianling Falls opened its maw wide and slammed into the fast ship.
hunks.sol: At Mu Song’s urgent shout, the whirlpool of Tianling Falls opened its maw wide and slammed into the swift ship.
[^1]: In Korean, “newbie” is commonly pronounced *nyubi*, which Mu Song mistakes for *Yubi*, the Korean reading of Liu Bei.
